Strategy: all kills in the afternoon. That rules out only day workers, so the pool starts at 55k. Pool = 55000 x the product of the fractions of my place-kinds that L can reach and has 3+ traced victims in. My kinds and fractions: regional:South .25, blotter (sector) .20, clips (age) .25, forum .25, foreign .25. Two kinds constrained gives ~2750-3400, which is safe. Three kinds gives 690-860, which means caught. National is always safe to kill. History: d1, d2 and d3 all 11 kills (33 total, multiplier x2 from d3). D4: killed ONLY national (d4-3), a deliberate pause. By end of d3, 15 traces (~14 non-national) had been spread over my kinds, so the third reachable kind was likely near 3 traced. Pausing lets the PC after d4 show the true state; national traces add nothing. The 5-day window still holds 33+1 on d5, so d5 is still x2. On d6, d1 drops out and the multiplier needs fresh kills. PCs: d0 100k/0, d2 60k/5 traced. Reading the PC after d4: pool 60k means nothing constrained. Pool 10k or 20k means one kind (10k could be blotter at 11k or another kind at 13.75k). Pool 3000 means two kinds. In that case only national and the already-constrained kinds are safe, but I cannot tell which two. One idea: watch the traced count. It only counts successful traces, and victims in unreachable kinds fail. Compare traced count growth against my kills per kind to guess which kinds are unreachable. If the d4 PC traced count is ~15, almost all traces succeeded (my kinds are mostly reachable). If it is much lower, many of my kinds are unreachable. Plan for d5: decide using the PC. If the pool is 3000, kill national plus at most 1-2 from kinds I judge constrained or unreachable. Avoid an unconstrained reachable third kind at all costs.

STATE after d5: the PC after d4 showed pool 3000 with 7 traced, so TWO of my place-kinds are already constrained. Traced 7 out of about 14 non-national traces fits 3 of my 5 kinds being reachable and 2 unreachable. So exactly one reachable kind is still unconstrained and probably close to 3 traced victims. I cannot tell which kind it is. Any non-national kill risks getting it traced, which pushes the pool to about 700-860 and gets me caught, losing half my points. DECISION: kill ONLY the national criminal each day, afternoon, quick entry. That is 1 point a day once the multiplier lapses (d5 still x2 because the window holds 34). Points before d5: 46. Keep doing national-only for every remaining day to day 30. Only reconsider if a PC shows something unexpected, but the pool never grows, so stay safe.
